name: text-only SMWS listing: creates an exact-cask bottle when the code is missing locally

provenance.notes: Re-verified September 3, 2026. The official SMWS product page identifies cask RW6.5 as Appley ever after, age 6, and 56% ABV, but does not state a release or bottling year. This is a controlled missing-local-Bottle variant: the real SMWS and Kyrö entities remain available while the Bottle catalog is empty. It intentionally tests exact-cask creation and does not describe current production, where Peated Bottle 43260 exists. The held-out Peated Bottle must not supply an expected release year through public web search.

expected.summary: Extract the SMWS code from raw title text and create the exact-cask bottle when no safe local candidate exists.
